description: Horizontal scrolling menu component for React with per-item visibility tracking via IntersectionObserver; mouse, touch, arrows, programmatic scrolling, SSR-safe
rules: Always import 'react-horizontal-scrolling-menu/dist/styles.css'; the JS bundle never injects CSS and without it the menu renders vertically
Every direct child of ScrollMenu needs a unique string itemId prop; that is how visibility tracking and scrollToItem find items

Read menu state with React.useContext(VisibilityContext) only inside components rendered under ScrollMenu; use the hooks useIsVisible(itemId, defaultValue), useLeftArrowVisible() and useRightArrowVisible()
Do not destructure visibleElements, isFirstItemVisible, isLastItemVisible or initComplete from the context; they were removed in v8, use the hooks instead

onWheel and onScroll are plain (api, event) => void callbacks; every mouse and touch prop (onMouseDown, onMouseUp, onMouseMove, onMouseLeave, onTouchStart, onTouchMove, onTouchEnd) is curried: (api) => (event) => void
Scroll imperatively with api.scrollToItem(api.getItemById(id), behavior, inline, block), scrollNext() and scrollPrev(); use apiRef only to fire methods from outside, never to read data
The component is client-only: add 'use client' in React Server Components; control SSR first paint with the defaultValue argument of useIsVisible
noPolyfill defaults to true since v8 (native scrollIntoView); transitionDuration (default 500) and transitionBehavior only take effect with noPolyfill={false}
